title: SafeSwap: per-request hypothesis runner with adaptive exposure budgets
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Build SafeSwap: a lightweight A/B experiment controller that runs per-request hypothesis checks and enforces adaptive exposure budgets. Goals: (1) allow per-route per-customer A/B and shadow experiments that incrementally increase exposure based on sequential statistical checks; (2) integrate synthetic probe traffic and shadow fidelity checks to detect semantic regressions early; (3) provide automatic rollback policies that combine statistical quality deltas with SLO regressions (P99 latency, error lift, and cost uplift); (4) expose experiment controls and signals in Redwood Console (metrics, early-warning alerts, suggested budget adjustments). Acceptance criteria: 1) API to create experiments with per-metric thresholds, exposure budget, and rollback actions; 2) Runtime support for per-request routing with weighted sampling and shadow fork; 3) Sequential test harness implementing a Bayesian sequential test with FDR control and configurable stopping rules; 4) Console UI surfaces showing cohort-level drift, probe failure counts, and suggested exposure changes; 5) End-to-end demo toggling a model v1->v2 canary to 2%, 10%, 50% with auto-stop on breach and fully documented runbook.
